metadata.title: User Guide: First Time Login Setup
metadata.description: Step-by-step guide for new users logging in for the first time
metadata.author: IoT Support Team

sections.title: Welcome Screen
sections.content:
First Login Welcome

When you log in for the first time, you'll be greeted with a welcome screen.

Welcome to IoT Monitoring System!
You're about to complete your profile setup.

This one-time setup ensures your account is secure and personalized.

sections.title: Change Default Password
sections.content:
Step 1: Update Your Password

For security reasons, you must change the temporary password provided by your administrator.

Password Requirements:

  • ✓ Minimum 8 characters
  • ✓ At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
  • ✓ At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
  • ✓ At least one number (0-9)
  • ✓ At least one special character (!@#$%^&*)

Enter:

  1. Current temporary password
  2. New password
  3. Confirm new password
Password Tips:
  • Use a unique password (don't reuse from other sites)
  • Avoid personal information (birthdate, name)
  • Consider using a password manager

sections.title: Complete Your Profile
sections.content:
Step 2: Fill Profile Information

Complete your user profile with the following information:

Required Fields:

  • Full Name: Your complete name
  • Email: Already filled (verify it's correct)
  • Phone Number: For alert notifications

Optional Fields:

  • Job Title: Your role in the organization
  • Department: Your department name
  • Profile Picture: Upload a photo (JPG/PNG, max 2MB)

Click when complete.

sections.title: Notification Preferences
sections.content:
Step 3: Configure Notifications

Choose how you want to receive system alerts and notifications:

Email Notifications:

SMS Notifications:

sections.title: Accept Terms & Policies
sections.content:
Step 4: Review and Accept

Before accessing the system, you must agree to the following:

Terms of Service

Review the Terms of Service document that outlines:

  • Acceptable use policy
  • User responsibilities
  • Data access rights
  • Account security obligations

Privacy Policy

Review the Privacy Policy that explains:

  • How your data is collected
  • How your data is used
  • Data retention policies
  • Your privacy rights

sections.title: Finish Setup
sections.content:
Step 5: Complete Setup

Once all steps are completed:

  1. Review all information entered
  2. Click
  3. Wait for confirmation message
Setup Complete!
Welcome aboard! You'll be redirected to your dashboard in 3 seconds...

What's Next?

After setup, you can:

  • Explore your dashboard
  • View assigned nodes and sensors
  • Check active alerts
  • Customize your dashboard widgets

Need help? Check out our User Guide tutorials.
